title: Type the monthly report totals
body:
The budget forecast (next PR) needs the monthly category totals as typed values, not the dicts the endpoint returns.

- `category_totals()` returns `CategoryTotal` dataclasses; `monthly_summary()` keeps returning the same dicts, built from them.
- The month check and the line formatting are pulled out into `in_month()` and `format_line()`.
- No output changes: same grouping, same "uncategorized" fallback, same order (largest spend first, then by name), same integer average.

Adds a test for the tie-break order, which was not covered.
